title: Tagi

usage: {entries, plural, one {# wpis} few {# wpisy} many {# wpisów} other {# wpisu}} · {projects, plural, one {# projekt} few {# projekty} many {# projektów} other {# projektu}} · {clients, plural, one {# klient} few {# klientów} many {# klientów} other {# klienta}}
